policy.compatibility: Lumen 4 may deliberately replace v3 component and binary contracts. Consumer data, privacy, and release approval remain protected. Migration guidance documents externally visible changes.
policy.versioning: Prepare the coordinated v4 candidate locally. Publication requires separate approval of the final reviewed revision through the existing GitHub release workflow.

changes.currentContract: Consumers carry chart-label, hidden-state, clipboard, date-selection, and native-layout workarounds across older Lumen releases.
changes.replacement: Shared chart geometry and formatted axes, strict range selection, explicit clipboard recovery, accessible native layout controls, and a cross-framework image comparison primitive.
changes.migration: Use stable unique chart X identities; remove verified old chart/hidden patches; review button content selectors and loading activation; rebuild native consumers for changed initializer and formatter contracts.

changes.currentContract: Seven v3 Swift initializer signatures do not expose compact chart, chart-data labels and formatting, slider-label, and symbol-selection options. The v3 icon enum lacks four reviewed catalog additions.
changes.replacement: Defaulted parameters provide bare chart frames, explicit plot height, localized interval-chart data and formatting, optional slider headings, contextual symbol tint, and selection completion. The icon enum adds bangladeshiTaka, layoutGridCircles, letters, and printer3d.
changes.migration: Rebuild consumers against v4. Existing source calls generally retain defaults; method references and binary clients must adopt the new signatures. Exhaustive LumenIconName switches must handle the four new cases or provide an appropriate fallback. See native composition examples and the v4 migration guide.

changes.currentContract: SwiftUI and Compose sheets wrap unbounded content without configurable dismissal protection; native required-field and tab-panel descriptions include fixed English text.
changes.replacement: Native sheet scroll and dismissal policies, keyboard-safe content, compact-height and large-text fallbacks, explicit React Native focus targets, and caller-localized accessibility descriptions.
changes.migration: Rebuild SwiftUI and Compose consumers for the new sheet signatures. Set scrollable false for application-owned lazy or virtualized content. Supply translated requiredLabel and panelAccessibilityLabel in Compose and React Native when needed.

changes.currentContract: Embedded Lumen MCP integrations import SDK v1 server and transport objects.
changes.replacement: The embedded server uses SDK v2 server, client and transport packages.
changes.migration: Migrate known SDK module paths, update SDK dependencies to compatible v2 packages, rebuild and test the real transport. Other SDK imports require manual review.

changes.currentContract: Theme palettes and surface dimensions are customized separately in each adapter. Swift surface and theme initializer signatures do not expose appearance or material options.
changes.replacement: Canonical Default, Studio and Glass appearances, scoped web tokens, ThemeBuilder dimensions and explicit surface material with native opaque fallbacks.
changes.migration: Choose a preset, then override semantic tokens or native appearance values. Glass remains explicit per surface. Rebuild Swift and Compose consumers; Swift initializer references must include the defaulted appearance and material parameters.

changes.currentContract: The v3 phone initializer does not expose presentation controls.
changes.replacement: Defaulted v4 selector, display format, placeholder, flag and size options for existing phone selection behavior.
changes.migration: Rebuild Swift consumers and update initializer references for the added defaulted phone presentation parameters.
